_about: TJD-643 optional post-template slots, keyed by post id (file name without .md). Every slot is empty until RP supplies it (RP's words only; nothing is written for RP). pullQuote must be an exact sentence from that post's body (the build fails otherwise). thisWeek = the 'What to do this week' callout text. sources = [{"title", "url"}]. chart = {"src": "/posts/<id>/<file>.svg", "alt"} for an original chart or diagram under public/. An empty slot is not rendered. See PRELAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md.
